properties.name: WHAT WORKED (2026-10-02, 0.77.0): `--call find_tools` is the door agent's only catalogue, and it works. It returns ranked tools with a one-sentence summary and parameter names, deterministically, in about 0.2 s. Do not regress it
properties.statement:
From art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, measured table row "`--call find_tools` | ranked tools with parameter names and summaries". Re-measured by triage agent B on 0.77.0 against a scratch import of main's export.
- Each item is {tool, score, summary, parameters}, and the reply also carries {count, matched, omitted, searched (193), query}.
- It ranks get_node 1st for "read one node by id", "fetch a node by id" and "pull up the full record for a requirement".
- Ties break by name, so the same query answers the same way twice.
A future change that adds schemas or lessons to this reply, or a describe door beside it (req:the-cli-describes-any-tool-with-its-full-schema-and-lessons), must keep the reply small and the ranking stable, because this is the call the instructions file sends every door agent to first.
